beacons.name: 806 N Carey Street
beacons.subtitle: Harlem Park · notice 30150A · EXTENSION
beacons.blurb: the first door. sealed by the city with concrete block behind its original frame — a masoned door does not open. you do not enter here. you enter through the gap the paperwork left.

strata.fragment: still — EXTENSION. twenty-one years. the notice never resolves. it is extended, indefinitely.
2004 — the notice. 30150A: condemned as unsafe for occupancy; the public is warned to keep away.
1961 — the plan. the inside of the block is cleared; woodyear and vincent streets erased, leaving inner-block parks no one asked to keep.
1937 — the map. a federal residential security map rings black west baltimore in red and stamps it D, 'hazardous.' not one building was inspected. the hazard it scored was the people.
